text: The grass is currently a very loud shade of purple, mostly because it is trying to scream at the sun. My goldfish, who has recently decided that swimming is just a metaphor for orbital mechanics, is now orbiting a floating crouton in the corner of the room. She insists that the glass bowl is actually a warp drive, though it mostly just makes her dizzy and causes the water to taste like Tuesday. She is currently drafting a thesis on how to colonize the ceiling fan, arguing that its rotation is clearly a signal from the Andromeda galaxy. I tried to tell her that planets don’t have feelings, but she just blew a bubble that spelled out "DENIED" in the air before popping it into a tiny, spherical void.
